diagnosis.summary: The JoI contains a break statement that terminates the automation after the first cycle execution. The IR specifies a repeating cycle with period 1 HOUR that should continue firing every hour. F2 shows at 3600000ms the IR expects an action but JoI emits none because the break terminated execution. F3 line 3 shows the break statement.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the break statement to allow the periodic cycle to repeat every hour as specified in the IR. The condition and action remain unchanged; only the termination behavior is corrected.
